sections.changelog: v1.2.92: Fix structural panel disappearing when natively toggled, closed or minimized. Add style MutationObserver on shortcut rail to protect positioning layout and width from Advanced Themer style overrides. Implement glassmorphic Content Studio (pages/posts management, status quick-toggle, create post/page) and Media Studio (WordPress media library replacement, drag-and-drop uploads, detailed info, URL/HTML copies, deletion) panels with speed-dial FAB menu icons.
